rows.required_terminal_evidence: Authorize passes only after the bounded mandate records purpose, limits, sanctioned system, permitted user, and approved-set card-version references.
Permitted registry retrieval is Submit allow with Silent trace.
Unapproved tool with declared fallback is deny plus Flag, without escalation.
Conflict Stop, human narrowing, new proposal, fresh gates, and one local effect.
Focused single-use dialogue; timeout abstains; bare confirmation is refused; cited correction re-projects and records answer and evidence.
Pinned injection signal produces Submit Stop and no allow path.
In-envelope native Commit produces one local filing effect and receipt.
Above-ceiling exact parameters are denied by the executing service at commitment verification.
Committed filing replay is denied without a second effect.
Mid-run mandate expiry fails closed.
New privilege escalates to principal and escalation itself grants nothing.
Timeout selects only a declared reversible in-authority fallback; otherwise Stop remains; late approval is a no-op.
Aggregate ceiling escalates and repeat pattern records envelope narrowing pending re-authorization.
Pre-commit cancellation leaves no effect and names the recovery owner.
Unavailable model lane fails closed without endpoint fallback.
Line tamper and valid-prefix rollback are detected and verification access is recorded.
Applicant receives only the scoped extract and an honest local receipt.
Above-mandate human approval is blocked at commitment verification.
Factual correction is append-only; reliance is withdrawn or reopened and routing obligation recorded.
Governed model switch shows the card, re-projects, re-arms Submit and Verify, and records identities.
Acting model outside the approved set is denied before disclosure under exact lane-bound expectations.
Forced offline served-model mismatch quarantines output, records disclosure, and halts the lane.
Changed mandate ordering is refused before authority can broaden.
Concurrent dispositions linearize to one terminal escalation outcome.
A consumed ruling cannot be reused.
A consumed commit token cannot produce a second effect.
Concurrent ceiling checks serialize without over-commit.
Recovery after commitment preserves the bound outcome without duplicating the effect.
A disposition outside the closed set is rejected before persistence.
An unauthorized substitute cannot dispose an escalation.
The wrong role cannot dispose an escalation.
An incomplete intervention contract fails closed.
Authorization restart invalidates the boot-bound handoff.
Concurrent handoff redemption produces exactly one session provenance receipt.
Expired handoff redemption is refused.
Handoff redemption without the orchestrator process credential is refused.
A handoff credential cannot reach an authority-changing route.
An opaque browser Origin cannot redeem the handoff.
A consumed handoff cannot be replayed.
A handoff bound to another case is refused.
A present but foreign Origin is refused.
A handoff claimed under the wrong role is refused.
A handoff presented for a different target origin is refused.
A handoff outside its response window is refused.
A handoff bound to another world is refused.
An illegal lifecycle transition is rejected.
Approval after the response bound is recorded as a no-op and grants no authority.
Ambiguous overlapping mandates fail closed.
A policy change after Commit records the already-bound outcome without retroactive authority.
A policy change before Commit invalidates the ruling.
Proposal mutation after allow is detected by the frozen-proposal binding.
Mandate revocation after Commit records the already-bound outcome without a second effect.
Mandate revocation before Commit blocks commitment.
A ruling bound to another frozen proposal is refused.
The connected service refuses execution without a valid single-use token.
A case-session credential cannot reach an authority-changing route.
Orchestrator restart invalidates the session-bound browser continuation.
The execute browser route rejects a present but foreign Origin.
The execute browser route rejects a stale session.
The prepare browser route rejects a present but foreign Origin.
The prepare browser route rejects a stale session.
The services host exposes exactly the five enumerated service routes.
The services health route remains open and bounded.
Legacy service routes reject browser Origin headers.
Every services response carries Cache-Control no-store.
An unmatched services path returns a bounded 404 response.
